peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 4.2% above its local comparables; 70 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (33.1): 2.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 85 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,480,000 ($1,966 psf, 1,237–1,668 sq ft; 7 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,887 psf (range $1,212–2,798); 4.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $100,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bayshore MRT about 350 m, Tanah Merah MRT about 1,260 m; closer than 377 of 462 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Temasek Primary School about 550 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 700 m), more than 206 of 462 similar developments (the same as 81); nearest hawker centre Bedok South Road Blk 16 about 730 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area F about 700 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 530 m; Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,370 m; Bagnall Haus, 11 new sales, about 1,620 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 85 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 400 new sales and 590 resales (990 purchases); new sales were 40.4% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,250 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 590 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 173 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 590 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 615 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.1%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
